reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The ifiles private c_int owns the count of linked nodes, initially zero and adjusted by link_ifile/unlink_ifile; it owns no node memory itself.
owner_creation.invariant: File count is metadata, not a resource owner.
limitations: ifiles counts membership and owns no node or filename.

aliases_escapes.analysis: nifile copies the ifiles count to callers; no address escapes, but count accuracy depends on raw list updates completing together.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A copied count cannot establish node lifetime.
limitations: A count value cannot prove circular links or held IFILE handles are valid.

callback_targets.analysis: There is no callback stored in this ifiles integer; surrounding mark/disposal calls belong to the node operations that adjust it.
callback_targets.invariant: Count metadata cannot register callback ownership.
limitations: List mutation calls update the count without an owning callback context.

invalidation.analysis: Deleting a node decrements the ifiles value without retiring any caller-held node pointer; count changes cannot be used as generation checks.
invalidation.invariant: Count decrements do not invalidate external aliases safely.

mutation_commit.analysis: ifiles increments/decrements only after neighboring links and indexes change; an interruption can separate count and membership publication.
mutation_commit.invariant: Count and list membership lack a joint commit guard.

release_pair.analysis: This ifiles scalar is not freed; freeing a node only logically removes one count contribution and must not release the count object.
release_pair.invariant: Static count storage survives every node deletion.
limitations: Decrementing ifiles does not substitute for del_ifile node and name release.

error_cleanup.analysis: No overflow/error policy protects the signed count or restores ifiles after partial list mutation; this limitation belongs to the existing raw-core finding.
error_cleanup.invariant: Count arithmetic has no proved upper-bound contract here.

signals_handoff.analysis: The ifiles counter is a mutable static rather than atomic main-loop-owned state; interrupted traversal or cleanup has no synchronization contract.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.
